---
title: "Folder and file-naming starter"
last-reviewed: "2026-08-28"
---

Adapt the structure to approved storage, data sensitivity, method and team practice. Identifiable or restricted material may need a separate controlled system.

## Starter structure

```text
project/
  README.md
  admin/
  protocol/
  data/
    00_incoming/
    01_raw_read_only/
    02_interim/
    03_analysis_ready/
    04_release/
  code/
  outputs/
    figures/
    tables/
    reports/
  metadata/
  logs/
```

**Authoritative copy for each folder:** [ ]
**Folders prohibited from sync, repository or local device:** [ ]
**Read-only enforcement for raw material:** [ ]
**Access owner and review date:** [ ]

## Naming convention

**Pattern:** `[project]_[item]_[context]_[YYYY-MM-DD]_[status-or-version].[ext]`

**Allowed separators and case:** [ ]
**Controlled status/version terms:** [draft / reviewed / approved / raw / derived / release]
**Prohibited content:** participant names, sensitive attributes, credentials, unexplained initials, `final2`, `latest`

| Good example | Why it works |
|---|---|
| `atlas_interview-guide_2026-08-28_approved-v3.docx` | project, item, date and controlled version are visible |
| `atlas_device-export_2026-08-28_raw.csv` | raw state is explicit and should remain read-only |
| `atlas_sample-flow_2026-08-28_draft.qmd` | editable source is distinguished from rendered output |

## README prompts

- purpose and scope of the project;
- owner, contact and last review date;
- where restricted data actually live;
- folder and data-state meanings;
- setup or processing sequence;
- naming, version and metadata rules;
- prohibited actions;
- backup and recovery route; and
- closure or handover instructions.

## Completed scenario

Two files are named `clean_data_final.csv` and `clean_data_final_NEW.csv`. Inspection shows that one excludes withdrawals and the other changes timezone conversion. Rename neither until provenance is reconstructed. Preserve both, record checksums and origins, reproduce transformations from raw data, create a defined analysis-ready output and document the exclusions and timezone rule. Naming cannot substitute for a derivation record.
